name: thunk-skills
description: How to build, test and analyze thunks with the Thunk.AI Builder MCP, and next-step suggestions after Codex uses a Builder tool. Also install the plugin for your Thunk.AI tenant, for the tools.

interface.shortDescription: Build, test and analyze Thunk.AI thunks
interface.longDescription: The thunk-guide skill: which Thunk.AI help articles to read, the order to build a thunk in, and how to test, troubleshoot and clean up a thunk. Its hooks suggest the next step after Codex uses a Builder tool and show the Thunk.AI cards in the Codex app. Also install the plugin for your Thunk.AI tenant, for the Builder MCP tools.
defaultPrompt: I'm new to Thunk.AI. Interview me about a process to automate, then build it as a thunk I can watch.
Give me a guided tour of Thunk.AI in the browser pane, using a public sample thunk.
Ask me about my role and team, then suggest three processes Thunk.AI could automate for me.
